description:
FindEZ gives your physical world a memory. Keep track of what you own, where it belongs, and what you need next.

For individuals, small businesses, labs, factories, makerspaces, and robotics teams.

CAPTURE AND ORGANIZE
- Scan barcodes or take a photo to identify items.
- Review uncertain results before confirming them.
- Organize belongings, tools, parts, and supplies into Spaces.
- Keep quantities, locations, notes, and item photos together.
- Import spreadsheets to bring existing inventory into FindEZ.

FIND WHAT YOU NEED
- Search your inventory in your own words.
- Ask FindEZ about your things, places, or projects.
- Attach a photo to a question for extra context.

WORK TOGETHER
- Share Spaces and collaborate in Teams.
- Choose whether to join when opening an invitation link.
- Manage shared documents, team activity, and item lending.

PLAN PURCHASES
- Keep a list of items to buy and track what is on order.
- Record arrival by confirming the stock you have on hand.
- Purchase plans are saved for your account on your device. Inventory quantities sync with FindEZ.

Built by AI Robots Inc.
whatsNew:
- A refreshed Home, Capture, Ask, Find, and Profile experience with consistent typography and restrained brand accents.
- Share Spaces and Teams through invitation links, with an explicit choice to join.
- Keep item photos and add a photo to Ask FindEZ.
- Review uncertain photo-extraction results before confirming them.
- Use the Restock planner to track items to buy, items on order, and confirmed arrivals.
- Organize documents and notes from Profile.
- Improved inventory loading, account safety, and error handling.
notes:
This dedicated review account contains sample inventory only. Sign in using the credentials provided in Sign-In Information.

Navigation: Home shows inventory summaries. Capture offers barcode scanning and photo extraction. Ask supports text questions and a photo attachment. Find opens Spaces and Teams. Profile opens settings, documents and notes, notifications, and account actions.

New in 1.0.7: refreshed navigation and typography; item photos; photo questions; uncertain-result review; shared Space and Team invitation links; Profile documents and notes; and the Restock planner.

Restock planner: open Find, then the purchase summary. Add an item, mark it ordered, and use Record arrival to confirm the total stock on hand. Purchase planning is local to the signed-in account and device. Actual inventory quantities use the existing inventory service.

Invitations: opening an invitation link does not grant membership. The recipient must explicitly choose Join. Shared access follows the owner's permissions.

This build does not add subscription purchases or a payment checkout. Account deletion is available in Profile > Settings > Account Settings.
